subject: POC Success Criteria & KPI Proposal - Atlas Payments trial
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@atlas-payments.com>, Samir Patel <samir@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC Success Criteria & KPI Proposal - Atlas Payments trial

Thanks for the call today - great context on your fraud-detection pilot and the throughput patterns you shared. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass recommended success criteria / KPI set for the POC so we can align on measurable outcomes before we start (redwood_poc_kpis_v1.xlsx). Key asks in this email: please confirm owners, any metric changes, and whether the proposed timeline (kickoff week of June 26) works for your team.

Summary (high level):
- Primary goal: Validate model quality and cost economics for real-time transaction enrichment in the fraud pipeline.
- Success window: 2-week POC (config + run), followed by 1-week evaluation.

Proposed POC KPIs (initial):
- Latency: p95 end-to-end response < 300 ms (service endpoint -> model -> response).
- Throughput: sustained 50 requests/sec during baseline, ability to handle 150 req/sec burst for short windows.
- Cost: average cost/token <= $0.002 (target; measured as normalized cost/token across traffic).
- Quality: intent/label alignment >= 95% on the labelled test set (we'll define exact evaluation rules).
- Reliability: error rate < 1% and no more than 2 service incidents during the POC.

Open items for your confirmation:
1) Do these KPIs match your expectations? Any thresholds you'd like to tighten/loosen?
2) Who will own the test data and labelled evaluation sets on Atlas side?
3) Do you have any specific security/compliance checkpoints we should include in the timeline?

Next steps:
- If acceptable, we'll produce an updated KPI spreadsheet with owner columns and an evaluation plan (attack plan: datasets, synthetic load, metrics reporting).
- Proposed owners (Redwood): Jordan (trial lead), Marissa (infrastructure/config), Stephanie (metrics/eval).

Thanks - I'll wait for your changes and can update the doc for sign-off.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_poc_kpis_v1.xlsx

From: Elena Garcia <elena@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@atlas-payments.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@atlas-payments.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & KPI Proposal - Atlas Payments trial

Jordan - thanks for the clear recap and the spreadsheet. A few edits from our side:

- Latency: can we tighten p95 to 250 ms? Our real-time stack needs lower tail latency for fraud decisions.
- Throughput: target baseline 50 rps is fine but we need peak handling of 100 rps sustained for up to 15 minutes during spikes.
- Cost: that target looks reasonable but please include examples of tokens-per-transaction so we can estimate monthly run cost.
- Quality: we agree on ~95% for the labelled set, but we also want a separate user-acceptance check on edge cases (we'll provide a 500-row edge-case file).

Security/compliance: we need model logging (per-request metadata, redacted PII) and proof that logs are retained per our retention policy (90 days). Please confirm PII masking support and the logging schema.

Owners on our side: Samir will provide the labelled set, Sam Lee (procurement) will be the contact for terms and PO.

If you can update the spreadsheet to reflect the new thresholds and add an owners column, we can sign-off and kick off the week of June 26. Also please send a secure upload link for the test dataset.

Thanks,
Elena Garcia
Head of Data Product
Atlas Payments

--
Elena Garcia
Atlas Payments

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Atlas POC - infra checklist

Quick internal note to capture infra/action items raised by Atlas: 
- Need to confirm PII masking in logging path and share logging schema.
- Prepare a staging environment that mirrors Atlas network egress rules (VPC peering details to follow).
- Load testing plan: steady-state 50 rps, spike tests to 150 rps for short bursts; Elena asks sustained 100 rps for 15 minutes.
- Produce cost examples per transaction (tokens per typical transaction sample) - Jordan can get a sample from Atlas.

Stephanie: can you own the evaluation harness and metric dashboard? I can own infra provisioning and the staging config. Jordan: I'll work with infra to get the upload link for their dataset and pre-provision service capacity for the trial date.

-Marissa
VP, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@atlas-payments.com>, Samir Patel <samir@atlas-payments.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & KPI Proposal - Atlas Payments trial

Elena / Samir / Sam - thanks for the fast feedback. We've incorporated your asks and updated the KPI doc (attached redwood_poc_kpis_v2.xlsx). High-level updates:
- Latency p95 target updated to 250 ms.
- Throughput: baseline 50 rps, sustained peak 100 rps for 15 minutes, burst tolerance to 150 rps.
- Added tokens-per-transaction examples column (you'll see 3 sample transaction sizes).
- Added owners column and an "Acceptance" checklist mapping to exact evaluation steps.
- Logging: included logging schema and masking notes (per-request id, redacted cardholder fields, event timestamp). Marissa is owning infra and will share the secure upload link.

Proposed timeline:
- June 21: Redwood to provision staging + upload link (Marissa).
- June 24: Atlas uploads labelled + edge-case datasets; Redwood sanity checks.
- June 27: Kickoff + run baseline tests.
- June 27 - July 8: POC execution window (2 weeks).
- July 9 - 12: Evaluation and sign-off period.

Owners: Jordan (trial lead, PM), Marissa (infra & uploads), Stephanie (metrics & evaluation dashboard), Samir (labelled data + validation), Elena (business acceptance), Sam Lee (procurement/PO).

Please respond with any blocking issues. If you approve, we'll add this to the HubSpot deal and schedule the June 27 kickoff for 9am PT.

Best,
Jordan

Attachments: redwood_poc_kpis_v2.xlsx
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

From: Elena Garcia <elena@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@atlas-payments.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@atlas-payments.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & KPI Proposal - Atlas Payments trial

Thanks Jordan - this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. Confirming:
- We accept the adjusted KPI thresholds (p95 250ms, baseline/peak throughput as listed).
- Samir will upload the labelled set and the 500-row edge-case file to the secure link once Marissa shares it.
- Procurement (Sam Lee) will expedite PO paperwork once we hit kickoff.
- Security: please share the logging schema and retention note in a short doc we can include in our audit folder.

Please go ahead and schedule the kickoff for June 27 at 9am PT. Looking forward to the trial - I'll share a calendar invite and the internal participants.

Best regards,
Elena Garcia
Head of Data Product
Atlas Payments

--
